To: r.delacruz@harborlinelogistics.com
From: s.whitfield@meridianofficesolutions.com
Date: 14 September
Subject: Your service agreement renewal
Attachment: Renewal_Terms_2026.pdf

Dear Ms. Delacruz,

Our records indicate that Harborline Logistics' maintenance agreement with Meridian Office Solutions is scheduled to expire on 31 October. As your account representative, I want to make sure that moving into a new term is as smooth as possible for your staff.

I have attached a summary of the plans available to you. The standard plan remains unchanged at $1,850 annually and covers quarterly inspections of every copier and printer at your Riverside Avenue location. I would nonetheless encourage you to look at our Premium plan this year. For an additional $400, it extends coverage to your two satellite offices and guarantees a technician on site within four hours of a reported malfunction, rather than on the following business day.

I understand that your team has grown considerably since we last spoke, so the wider coverage may well prove worthwhile. If you would like to talk the options through, I am free for a call any afternoon next week. Please also note that agreements renewed before 15 October qualify for a five percent discount, which is applied automatically when we issue the invoice.

Should you prefer to keep your current arrangement exactly as it is, simply reply to this message and I will process the paperwork on your behalf.

Best regards,

Simon Whitfield
Account Representative
Meridian Office Solutions

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?
options: To announce an increase in service fees
To confirm that a repair has been completed
To encourage a client to renew a contract
To introduce a newly hired representative
questions.explanation: 定位：第一段第一句指出維護合約將於 10 月 31 日到期，第二段起說明可續約的方案並鼓勵改採高級方案，全信目的即促成續約。(A) 錯：信中明說標準方案價格「維持不變」，並無漲價。(B) 錯：信中談的是未來的檢修服務，未提及任何已完成的維修。(D) 錯：Whitfield 自述為「您的客戶專員」，是既有窗口，並非新到職人員介紹。

questions.q: What is suggested about Harborline Logistics?
options: It has hired additional staff members.
It plans to relocate its headquarters.
It has complained about slow repair service.
It purchased new printers last quarter.
questions.explanation: 定位：第三段第一句「I understand that your team has grown considerably since we last spoke」，團隊大幅成長即暗示人員增加。(B) 錯：信中只提到既有的 Riverside 大道據點與兩處分處，沒有搬遷計畫。(C) 錯：四小時到場保證是寄件人主動推銷的賣點，並非回應客戶抱怨。(D) 錯：影印機與印表機是受檢修的既有設備，未提及近期採購。

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned in the e-mail?
options: The date on which the current agreement ends
The annual price of the standard plan
The name of an attached document
The number of technicians the company employs
questions.explanation: 定位：(A) 見第一段「expire on 31 October」；(B) 見第二段「$1,850 annually」；(C) 見信頭「Attachment: Renewal_Terms_2026.pdf」。三者皆有提及。(D) 信中只保證「四小時內派技師到場」，從未說明公司聘有多少技師，故為未提及者。

questions.q: The word "extends" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
options: postpones
broadens
repeats
measures
questions.explanation: 定位：第二段「it extends coverage to your two satellite offices」，此處指把服務範圍「擴大」到分處辦公室，故最接近 broadens。(A) 錯：extend 雖有「延期」義，但受詞是 coverage（範圍）而非期限，語意不通。(C) 錯：並非重複既有服務。(D) 錯：句中沒有測量的意思。

translation:
收件人：r.delacruz@harborlinelogistics.com
寄件人：s.whitfield@meridianofficesolutions.com
日期：9 月 14 日
主旨：您的服務合約續約事宜
附件：Renewal_Terms_2026.pdf

親愛的 Delacruz 女士：

根據本公司紀錄，Harborline Logistics 與 Meridian Office Solutions 之間的維護合約預計於 10 月 31 日到期。身為您的客戶專員，我希望讓貴公司同仁在換約時盡可能順利。

隨信附上可供您選擇的方案摘要。標準方案價格維持不變，每年 1,850 美元，涵蓋貴公司 Riverside 大道據點所有影印機與印表機的季度檢修。不過我仍建議您今年看看我們的高級方案。只要再加 400 美元，服務範圍即可延伸到貴公司的兩處分處辦公室，並保證在接獲故障通報後四小時內派技師到場，而不是等到下一個工作日。

我了解貴團隊自我們上次洽談以來已大幅成長，因此較大的服務範圍很可能相當值得。若您想討論這些方案，我下週任何一天下午都能通話。另請留意，10 月 15 日前完成續約者可享百分之五折扣，開立發票時將自動折抵。

若您希望完全維持現行的合約內容，只需回覆本信，我會代為處理相關文件。

謹致問候

Simon Whitfield
客戶專員
Meridian Office Solutions

THE LOFT AT CANTER STREET
Flexible Workspace for Growing Teams

Opening 3 March in the heart of the Westbrook business district, The Loft at Canter Street offers 2,400 square metres of thoughtfully designed office space, just two blocks from the Westbrook Metro station.

MEMBERSHIP OPTIONS

Drop-In Desk - $28 per day
Access to the open work floor, high-speed internet, and unlimited coffee. No reservation required.

Dedicated Desk - $310 per month
Your own desk in a shared studio, a locking cabinet, and eight hours of meeting-room credit every month.

Private Suite - from $980 per month
An enclosed office for teams of three to ten, with a company name plate at the entrance and twenty-four-hour building access.

All members enjoy the rooftop terrace, showers and secure bicycle storage, and a programme of evening workshops led by business owners from the neighbourhood.

FOUNDING MEMBER OFFER
Sign a twelve-month agreement before 28 February and pay nothing for your first month. This offer cannot be combined with the referral credit described on our website.

Tours run on weekdays between 9:00 A.M. and 6:00 P.M. To arrange one, call 555-0142 or write to hello@loftcanterstreet.com and ask for Marisol Fenn, our community manager.

questions.q: For whom is the advertisement most likely intended?
options: Residents looking for apartments
Companies in search of office space
Contractors bidding on a renovation project
Students applying for internships
questions.explanation: 定位：標題下方「Flexible Workspace for Growing Teams」與內文「2,400 square metres of thoughtfully designed office space」，並列出座位與套間的月租方案，訴求對象顯然是需要辦公空間的公司或團隊。(A) 錯：全篇租的是辦公空間，不是住宅。(C) 錯：廣告是招租，不是發包工程。(D) 錯：文中沒有任何實習或徵才資訊。

questions.q: What is stated about the Dedicated Desk option?
options: It is limited to newly founded businesses.
It may be used only during business hours.
It includes a monthly allowance of meeting-room time.
It costs twenty-eight dollars per day.
questions.explanation: 定位：MEMBERSHIP OPTIONS 的 Dedicated Desk 條目「eight hours of meeting-room credit every month」，即每月含會議室使用額度。(A) 錯：廣告未對申請者資格設限。(B) 錯：時間限制只出現在參觀導覽（平日 9:00 至 18:00），並非固定座位的使用時段。(D) 錯：每日 28 美元是 Drop-In Desk 的價格，固定座位為每月 310 美元。

questions.q: What is NOT listed as a benefit available to all members?
options: Use of an outdoor terrace
Secure storage for bicycles
Workshops hosted by local business owners
Entry to the building at any hour
questions.explanation: 定位：「All members enjoy the rooftop terrace, showers and secure bicycle storage, and a programme of evening workshops」一句已涵蓋 (A)(B)(C)。(D) 的二十四小時大樓出入權限只列在 Private Suite 條目底下，屬該方案專屬，並非全體會員都有，故為正解。

questions.q: What is indicated about the founding member offer?
options: It cannot be used together with a referral credit.
It remains available throughout the month of March.
It reduces the monthly rate by half.
It applies only to private suites.
questions.explanation: 定位：FOUNDING MEMBER OFFER 末句「This offer cannot be combined with the referral credit described on our website.」(B) 錯：截止日為 2 月 28 日，開幕日 3 月 3 日之後已不適用。(C) 錯：優惠內容是首月免費，不是月租打對折。(D) 錯：條件是簽訂十二個月合約，未限定必須承租獨立套間。

translation:
CANTER 街閣樓工作空間
為成長中的團隊打造的彈性辦公室

Canter 街閣樓將於 3 月 3 日在 Westbrook 商業區的核心地段開幕，提供 2,400 平方公尺精心規劃的辦公空間，距離 Westbrook 捷運站僅兩個街區。

會員方案

臨時座位 — 每日 28 美元
可使用開放式工作區、高速網路，以及無限量咖啡。無須預約。

固定座位 — 每月 310 美元
在共用工作室中擁有專屬座位、一個附鎖置物櫃，以及每月八小時的會議室使用額度。

獨立套間 — 每月 980 美元起
可容納三至十人團隊的封閉式辦公室，門口設有公司名牌，並享二十四小時大樓出入權限。

所有會員均可使用頂樓露臺、淋浴間與自行車安全停放區，並可參加由在地企業主帶領的夜間工作坊系列課程。

創始會員優惠
2 月 28 日前簽訂十二個月合約，首月免費。本優惠不得與本網站所述的推薦回饋合併使用。

參觀導覽於平日上午 9 時至下午 6 時進行。欲預約請撥 555-0142，或來信 hello@loftcanterstreet.com 洽社群經理 Marisol Fenn。

passages.content:
NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS
Ashfield Tower Property Management
Posted: 6 April

Beginning Monday, 20 April, the ground-floor lobby of Ashfield Tower will undergo a six-week renovation. The work will include replacing the flooring, upgrading the security desk, and installing a new visitor registration system.

While the renovation is under way, the main entrance on Delaney Street will be closed. Tenants and their guests should instead use the north entrance on Palmer Lane, which will be staffed from 6:00 A.M. until 10:00 P.M. daily. Outside those hours, the Palmer Lane door may be opened with a building access card.

Deliveries will continue to be received at the loading dock, but couriers must now telephone the tenant directly rather than leaving packages at the security desk. We recommend that each office designate one employee to coordinate deliveries for the duration of the project.

Two of the four passenger elevators will be taken out of service for short periods, generally between 10:00 A.M. and 2:00 P.M. To reduce waiting times, tenants on the second and third floors are encouraged to use the staircase whenever possible.

Questions and concerns may be directed to the management office in Suite 210 or to Gerald Ocampo at extension 4470. We appreciate your patience and expect all work to be finished by the end of May.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To announce an increase in office rents
To recruit volunteers for a tenant committee
To advertise office suites that are available
To inform occupants about scheduled building work
questions.explanation: 定位：第一段「the ground-floor lobby of Ashfield Tower will undergo a six-week renovation」，其後各段全在說明工程期間的動線與收貨安排，公告目的即告知施工事宜。(A) 錯：全文未提租金。(B) 錯：只建議各辦公室指派一人統籌收發包裹，並非招募委員會義工。(C) 錯：公告對象是現有承租戶，沒有招租內容。

questions.q: According to the notice, what will change about deliveries?
options: Couriers will contact recipients themselves.
Packages will be accepted only in the morning.
The loading dock will be closed temporarily.
Deliveries will have to be signed for by a manager.
questions.explanation: 定位：第三段「couriers must now telephone the tenant directly rather than leaving packages at the security desk」，改由快遞直接聯絡收件承租戶。(B) 錯：公告未限制收貨時段；10:00 至 14:00 的時段限制講的是電梯停用，與收貨無關。(C) 錯：同段明言「Deliveries will continue to be received at the loading dock」，卸貨區照常收貨。(D) 錯：公告只建議指派一名同仁協調，並未要求由主管簽收。

questions.q: What are tenants on the second and third floors encouraged to do?
options: Work from home during April
Reserve an elevator in advance
Take the stairs when they can
Enter the building from Delaney Street
questions.explanation: 定位：第四段末句「tenants on the second and third floors are encouraged to use the staircase whenever possible」。(A) 錯：公告從未提及在家上班。(B) 錯：電梯只是短時間停用，沒有預約制度。(D) 錯：Delaney 街正門在施工期間封閉，應改走 Palmer 巷北側入口。

questions.q: What is suggested about the north entrance?
options: It will remain closed during the renovation.
A card is needed to enter it late at night.
It is reserved for delivery personnel.
It was renovated earlier this year.
questions.explanation: 定位：第二段「staffed from 6:00 A.M. until 10:00 P.M. daily. Outside those hours, the Palmer Lane door may be opened with a building access card.」深夜已超出留守時段，故須持門禁卡進入。(A) 錯：封閉的是 Delaney 街正門，北側入口正是替代動線。(C) 錯：快遞走的是卸貨區。(D) 錯：即將翻修的是一樓大廳，文中未提北側入口已整修。

translation:
全體承租戶公告
Ashfield Tower 物業管理處
公告日期：4 月 6 日

自 4 月 20 日（星期一）起，Ashfield Tower 一樓大廳將進行為期六週的翻修工程。工程項目包括更換地板、升級警衛櫃臺，以及安裝新的訪客登記系統。

翻修期間，Delaney 街的正門將封閉。承租戶及訪客請改走 Palmer 巷的北側入口，該入口每日上午 6 時至晚上 10 時有人員留守。上述時段以外，可持大樓門禁卡開啟 Palmer 巷側門。

貨物仍於卸貨區收受，但快遞人員今後須直接以電話聯絡承租戶，不得將包裹留在警衛櫃臺。建議各辦公室在工程期間指派一名同仁統籌收發包裹事宜。

四部載客電梯中將有兩部短時間停止運轉，時段大致在上午 10 時至下午 2 時之間。為縮短候梯時間，敬請二樓與三樓的承租戶盡量改走樓梯。

如有疑問或意見，請洽 210 室的管理辦公室，或撥分機 4470 與 Gerald Ocampo 聯絡。感謝各位耐心配合，全部工程預計於 5 月底完工。

msgs.text: Morning, Tomas. I'm at the convention centre. Our booth panels arrived, but the crate with the display monitors isn't here. Have you heard anything from the shipper?
That's not good. Let me check the tracking. The panels and the monitors went out on separate trucks, so the second one may simply be running behind.
Tracking says the second crate left the warehouse at 6:10 this morning and is out for delivery. There's no estimated arrival time, though.
Setup access ends at 4:00 P.M. and the hall opens to visitors at nine tomorrow. I'd rather not gamble on this.
Understood. Halvorsen Rentals is three streets away and carries the same 55-inch screens. Want me to reserve two of them?
Let's not put all our eggs in one basket. Book them, and if our crate turns up before noon I'll cancel the reservation.
Done. We can pick them up any time after 1:00 P.M., and they'll take them back at no charge if we return them unused today.
Perfect. I'll keep unpacking the panels and let you know the moment the driver shows up.

questions.q: Where most likely is Ms. Nakamura?
options: At a printing shop
At a trade show venue
At a shipping warehouse
At a rental agency
questions.explanation: 定位：9:42 訊息「I'm at the convention centre」，加上 10:03 提到布展時間與「the hall opens to visitors at nine tomorrow」，可知她人在展覽會場。(A) 錯：對話中沒有印刷業務。(C) 錯：倉庫只出現在追蹤紀錄裡，是貨物的所在地而非她的位置。(D) 錯：Halvorsen 租賃行在三條街外，是 Reyes 先生提議去訂螢幕的地方。

questions.q: What problem does Ms. Nakamura report?
options: Some equipment has not arrived.
A booth was assigned to another company.
A monitor was damaged in transit.
An event has been rescheduled.
questions.explanation: 定位：9:42 訊息「the crate with the display monitors isn't here」，即裝螢幕的木箱尚未送達。(B) 錯：展位歸屬沒有爭議，她已在拆裝板材。(C) 錯：螢幕根本還沒到，談不上運送途中損壞。(D) 錯：展場開放時間如常為明天九點，並未改期。

questions.q: At 10:15 A.M., what does Ms. Nakamura most likely mean when she writes, "Let's not put all our eggs in one basket"?
options: She wants to compare prices at several rental firms.
She thinks the booth design should be simplified.
She prefers to arrange a backup instead of relying on the delivery.
She is certain the shipment will arrive before noon.
questions.explanation: 定位：這句緊接在 Reyes 先生 10:09 提議「Want me to reserve two of them?」之後，且她隨即說「Book them, and if our crate turns up before noon I'll cancel」，語意是不把希望全押在那批貨上，先備妥替代方案。(A) 錯：她沒有要比價，只指定 Halvorsen 一家。(B) 錯：對話完全沒談展位設計。(D) 錯：她 10:03 才說「I'd rather not gamble on this」，正是因為不確定貨會不會準時到。

questions.q: What is indicated about Halvorsen Rentals?
options: It will deliver the screens to the booth.
It requires payment in advance.
It is located inside the convention centre.
It accepts returns of unused items without a fee.
questions.explanation: 定位：10:21 訊息「they'll take them back at no charge if we return them unused today」。(A) 錯：同一句說「We can pick them up any time after 1:00 P.M.」，是自行取貨而非對方送達。(B) 錯：對話中完全未提付款方式或時間。(C) 錯：10:09 明說該租賃行在三條街外（three streets away），不在會場內。

translation:
Deirdre Nakamura（上午 9:42）
Tomas，早。我人在會議中心。我們的展位板材到了，但裝顯示螢幕的木箱沒到。你那邊有收到貨運公司的消息嗎？

Tomas Reyes（上午 9:47）
這可不妙。我查一下追蹤紀錄。板材和螢幕是分兩輛卡車出的貨，第二批可能只是慢了。

Tomas Reyes（上午 9:58）
追蹤顯示第二箱今天早上 6 點 10 分離開倉庫，已在配送途中。不過沒有預估送達時間。

Deirdre Nakamura（上午 10:03）
布展通行時間下午 4 點就結束，展場明天九點開放參觀。我不想賭這一把。

Tomas Reyes（上午 10:09）
了解。Halvorsen 租賃行就在三條街外，他們有同款的 55 吋螢幕。要我先訂兩臺嗎？

Deirdre Nakamura（上午 10:15）
別把所有雞蛋放在同一個籃子裡。先訂下來，如果我們的木箱中午前送到，我再取消預訂。

Tomas Reyes（上午 10:21）
訂好了。下午 1 點以後隨時可以取貨，而且今天原封不動退還的話，他們不收費用。

Deirdre Nakamura（上午 10:26）
太好了。我先繼續拆板材，司機一出現我立刻通知你。

passages.content:
Regional Grocery Chain Bets on Smaller Stores
By Priya Anand, Business Desk

FAIRHAVEN - For three decades, Coastline Markets built its reputation on huge suburban supermarkets stocked with more than forty thousand items. Last month the company opened something rather different: a 400-square-metre shop on Bellweather Street, in a neighbourhood where few residents own a car.

The Bellweather branch carries roughly six thousand products, most of them fresh food and everyday household goods. Prepared meals occupy an entire wall near the entrance, and a small counter sells coffee to commuters heading for the bus stop outside.

"We were not winning new customers by adding another aisle of cereal," said chief operating officer Lena Brightwater. "The households we want to reach shop three or four times a week, on foot, for whatever they will eat that evening."

The shift reflects a wider trend. Urban populations across the region have risen steadily since 2019, while the average grocery basket has shrunk. Analysts note that smaller shops are also cheaper and faster to open: a compact branch can open for business within five months, compared with roughly two years for a full-sized supermarket.

Not everyone is convinced. Retail consultant Dev Okonjo warns that small shops operate on thin profit margins and rely heavily on foot traffic, which can disappear when a nearby office closes. Coastline nevertheless plans six more compact branches by next autumn, two of them in Fairhaven's harbour district.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: A grocery company's move into smaller retail formats
A shortage of fresh produce in a coastal region
The closure of several suburban supermarkets
A merger between two competing grocery chains
questions.explanation: 定位：標題「Regional Grocery Chain Bets on Smaller Stores」與第一段末句「the company opened something rather different: a 400-square-metre shop」，全文環繞 Coastline Markets 改開小型門市的策略。(B) 錯：文中完全沒提到生鮮供應短缺。(C) 錯：郊區大型超市只是對照背景，並未說明任何一家關店。(D) 錯：全文只有一家公司，無合併情事。

questions.q: According to the article, what is one advantage of compact branches?
options: They employ fewer part-time workers.
They can begin operating sooner than large stores.
They stock a wider selection of products.
They are usually built beside major motorways.
questions.explanation: 定位：第四段「a compact branch can open for business within five months, compared with roughly two years for a full-sized supermarket」，開店時間短得多。(A) 錯：文章從未提及人力配置或工讀生人數。(C) 錯：Bellweather 分店約六千項商品，遠少於大型店的四萬項。(D) 錯：新店選在少有人開車的社區，緊鄰電車站，與高速公路無關。

questions.q: What concern does Mr. Okonjo express?
options: That prepared meals spoil too quickly
That the company has expanded too slowly
That the stores depend on passing pedestrians
That rents in the harbour district are rising
questions.explanation: 定位：第五段「small shops operate on thin profit margins and rely heavily on foot traffic, which can disappear when a nearby office closes」，他擔心的正是對人流的高度依賴。(A) 錯：調理食品只在第二段作為商品描述出現，未涉及保存問題。(B) 錯：他的疑慮是擴張的風險，而非速度太慢；公司反而還要再開六家。(D) 錯：港區只在末句提到將設兩家分店，未談租金。

questions.q: The word "shrunk" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
options: risen sharply
changed direction
grown crowded
decreased in size
questions.explanation: 定位：第四段「the average grocery basket has shrunk」，與前半句都市人口「risen steadily」形成對比，指單次採買量變小。(A) 錯：意思正好相反。(B) 錯：句中沒有方向轉變的語意，那屬於前一句的 shift。(C) 錯：擁擠形容的是空間，不能用來描述採買份量。

translation:
區域連鎖超市押注小型門市
商業組記者 Priya Anand

Fairhaven 訊——三十年來，Coastline Markets 靠著郊區大型超市建立名聲，架上商品逾四萬項。上個月，這家公司開出的門市卻相當不同：一間位於 Bellweather 街、面積 400 平方公尺的店面，而該社區的居民鮮少擁有汽車。

Bellweather 分店約陳列六千項商品，多為生鮮食品與家庭日用品。入口附近整面牆擺放調理食品，一旁小櫃臺則向前往店外公車站的通勤族販售咖啡。

「再加一排麥片走道並不會為我們帶來新顧客，」營運長 Lena Brightwater 表示。「我們想觸及的家庭每週步行採買三到四次，買的是當天晚上要吃的東西。」

這項轉變呼應了更大的趨勢。本區都市人口自 2019 年以來穩定成長，平均每次採買的份量卻縮減。分析師指出，小型門市的開店成本較低、籌備也較快：小型分店五個月內即可開始營業，全尺寸超市則約需兩年。

並非所有人都被說服。零售顧問 Dev Okonjo 提醒，小型店面的利潤空間微薄，且高度倚賴人流，而一旦附近的辦公室關閉，人流可能瞬間消失。儘管如此，Coastline 仍計畫在明年秋天前再開六家小型分店，其中兩家設在 Fairhaven 的港區。
